subject: Request — marketplace co-funding credit split for CatalystCloud cohort 18
messages:
From: Megan Lee <megan@catalystcloud.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Co-funded pilot credits for CatalystCloud Cohort 18

Hi Avery & Ben,

Thanks again for the intro the other week. CatalystCloud is kicking off Cohort 18 (retail vertical) and we have three qualified pilot customers that want to test Redwood’s inference platform in the marketplace flow. Typical pilots are small but time-sensitive — the cohort starts the week of June 1.

We can commit to covering 40% of the promotional credits spent by pilot customers via our partner fund, and we’d like Redwood to cover the remaining 60% as co-funding to make the offers compelling in the listing. Target total credit pool is $30,000 (so Redwood would cover $18k).

Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to:
- Approve a co-funded marketplace promo pool for Cohort 18
- Split the voucher/entitlement so redemption shows both CatalystCloud and Redwood as sponsors in Marketplace telemetry
- Set a 120-day expiry on credits for these pilots

I attached a short outline of the cohort and proposed split (catalyst-cohort-18-terms.pdf). If this looks feasible, we’d love a quick approval and a one-page agreement (DocuSign) so we can list the offer by May 14.

Also, one of the pilots is a high-fit prospect, Nimbus Retail (contact: samantha@nimbusretail.com) — if we can route them to a dedicated Redwood AE during the trial window, that’d be ideal.

Appreciate it —
Megan
Megan Lee
Head of Partnerships, CatalystCloud

Attachments:
- catalyst-cohort-18-terms.pdf (pdf)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Lee <megan@catalystcloud.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-funded pilot credits for CatalystCloud Cohort 18

Megan —

Thanks for the note and the deck. High level, this is in the kind of scope we approve for marketplace co-funded offers, but a couple quick clarifying questions before I loop in Finance/Legal: 

1) Redemption model: Do you want a single pooled voucher that splits billing 60/40 on the backend, or two separate vouchers (one Redwood, one Catalyst) that clients redeem in sequence? We prefer a single SKU from Marketplace if possible for billing simplicity.

2) Expiry: You asked for 120 days. For production pilots we typically give 90 days, but we can consider 120 with a narrower usage cap. Is Catalyst comfortable with a 120-day window but a hard per-account cap of $5k?

3) Reporting & telemetry: We’ll need the Catalyst account ID in Marketplace and the list of pilot tenants to wire up attribution.

If you confirm those, I’ll push to Sales Ops and Legal (cc’ing Ben). We aim to turn around a one-pager within 3 business days once terms are confirmed.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Co-funded pilot credits for CatalystCloud Cohort 18

Looping Soojin for Sales Ops and legal routing. Avery — quick internal take: I’m OK with the 60/40 split but want to reduce Redwood’s exposure unless there’s a clear lead signal on Nimbus Retail (Samantha). Suggest Redwood commit $12k initially and allow top-up to $18k if Nimbus converts to a paid account within 60 days post-pilot.

Also prefer issuing a single Marketplace SKU with backend attribution rather than stacked vouchers — easier for redemption and attribution in our console.

Soojin: if we proceed, can you: 
- Prepare a co-funding matrix so Finance can model the exposure
- Confirm if Marketplace supports a 120-day expiry and per-account caps on a single SKU
- Draft a lightweight amendment (one pager) for DocuSign that lists the split, expiry, and top-up clause (if conversion occurs)

Thanks —
Ben
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-funded pilot credits for CatalystCloud Cohort 18

Ben/Avery —

Quick status: Marketplace supports a single SKU with partner attribution and can enforce per-account caps on redemption. Expiry windows: default 90 days, but ops can set 120 days for special partners (requires approvals and a short exception).

I’m attaching a draft co-funding matrix to illustrate exposure scenarios at different take-rates (cofunding-matrix.xlsx). For the one-pager I can reuse our standard co-funding template — key items to include: total pool, split %, per-account cap, expiry, top-up trigger (conversion), attribution tags, and signature block for Catalyst and Redwood.

If we set Redwood commit at $12k with a conditional top-up to $18k on conversion, Finance is comfortable with an exception. I’ll also prep the HubSpot deal and DocuSign envelope: HubSpot ID RDW-DEAL-202605-CAT18.

Soojin
